summary: myCart is an e-commerce application packaged into a single file, designed to handle online transactions. It provides functionality for processing payments via traditional credit cards and cryptocurrencies.
goodFor: This tool is a good fit if you need to quickly embed or deploy a lightweight shopping cart without managing a complex multi-service architecture.
watchOut: The single-file design and modest community adoption suggest it may lack advanced inventory management, plugin ecosystems, or extensive documentation compared to established e-commerce platforms.
deployNotes: Because it runs as a containerised Go application, you will typically need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and ensure persistent storage is attached if transaction data or state needs to be retained.
